# Contributing to Atlas

- Match existing markdown and scripting style in this skill repo.
- Run `node scripts/validate.js` before opening a PR; fix reported issues.
- Prefer **kebab-case** names for markdown and assets (exceptions: `SKILL.md`, `LICENSE`, and tooling-required names).

If you propose a behavioral change to the skill narrative, update `SKILL.md` and any referenced module files together so validators and links stay coherent.
